name: color-shift-tabbar
description: A plain rounded-rectangle tab bar with five evenly spaced tabs. The active tab carries no pill, bubble, or lift — it is shown purely by tinting its icon and label with the accent colour.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Index of the currently selected tab.

props.name: barFill
props.description: Background colour of the rounded bar surface. This is a layout prop, not a `menu` style override — the component applies it after the merged `menu` style, so it is the only way to actually change the bar's fill.

props.name: accent
props.description: Tint applied to the active tab's label. This is a layout prop, not an `activeTabLabel` style override — the component applies it after the merged `activeTabLabel` style, so it is the only way to actually change the active label's colour.

events.name: onChange
events.description: Fired when the active tab changes, with the newly selected index.
